in_marathi.name: Nabi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nakta', meaning 'night'. This name is associated with the god of the night, Lord Shiva, and evokes feelings of calmness and peace.

in_bengali.name: Nabi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nabi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nakta', meaning 'night'. This name is associated with the god of the night, Lord Shiva, and evokes feelings of calmness and peace.
